name: athenaeum
description: Append-only knowledge sidecar for Claude Code: remember/recall via the athenaeum MCP server, plus the passive SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit recall hooks, all run through a pinned athenaeum release via uv -- no system-wide pip install required.

knowledgePath.title: Knowledge base path
knowledgePath.description: Where athenaeum reads/writes raw observations and the compiled wiki. Default matches athenaeum serve's own --path default (~/knowledge). See this plugin's README, 'Supplying a real path', for why this value is NOT substituted into .mcp.json automatically.

_versionPinNote: This 'version' field is the SINGLE pinned athenaeum package version this plugin runs via uv (see hooks/launcher.sh) -- not an independent plugin-semver. tests/test_claude_code_plugin.py::test_manifest_version_pin_matches_pyproject fails CI if this drifts from pyproject.toml's [project].version. Bump both together at the weekly release (see README.md, 'Version-bump rule').
